items.heading: Fish Curry Seychellois
details: Key ingredients: fish, coconut milk, tomato, curry leaves
Marinate fish chunks with turmeric and lime.
Simmer coconut milk with tomato and curry leaves.
Add the fish and cook gently until just tender.
Serve the fragrant curry with rice.

items.heading: Grilled Fruit Bat Curry
details: Key ingredients: fruit bat or substitute meat, spices, coconut milk
Marinate the meat with a blend of local spices.
Brown the meat pieces well.
Simmer in coconut milk until tender.
Serve the rich curry over rice.

details: Ingredients: main vegetable/protein, onion, garlic, ginger, spices, tomato or coconut, oil and salt.

items.heading: Ladob
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
